structural_change: S81-DIE7/LAND 10-18: first hardened view of the S81 p4l lane-tail LANDING dsfd_dvland_276 (ot_s81_land W=276 D=4 KW=3; LANDING-CONTRACT L1-L7): ring of 4 slots written on the lane's forwarded clock ck_f (the slots ARE the capture flops, flop-first), read on the block root ck at slot (rc - K) mod 4 into the registered o (flop-last); k[2:0] = the per-lane identity strap K tied by the die binder; no ready / credit / occupancy (static calendar).  bind9 (claude/s81-die7-1018 3923ae6de, STRICT PASS): 108 inst: last station dsfd_dvrlyh_276_EW 48 / _WE 48 (MY) / _NS 8 / _SN 4.  Faces: lane i + ck_f on E (from the last relay station, as the _EW relays), o + ck + fault on W (abutted to the receiving block), rs / k strap on N; one master per width, the die mirrors it (MY / MX) for the opposite lane direction.  Outline 36.72 x 51.84 um: data faces E/W sized from 277 pins at <= 6 pins/um (5.34/um on 51.84 um), depth from the closure-measured std area 791 um2 at util ~0.51 (l1 route at 34.56 x 47.52: FLOORPLAN_MARGIN util 60.5% > 60%; grown in both axes, pins and faces unchanged).  Two CTS roots (multiple_cts_roots): ck_f (lane domain: i, ring slots, wc, epochs) and ck (core: rs, k, rc / warm / fault / o), related same frequency (one PLL, fixed-phase; the lane phase dL is the die's, checked by the die STA as the landing window MCP -setup E -hold D-1).  Slot write enables stay enable muxes as the RTL (the contract's per-slot ICG note is not adopted: no RTL change under the closed bind9; the Qwen qfd_landh kits do the same).  Recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die, M5 cap.
